thread:
sophie.dev: FYI customers keep importing our SDK directly in `use client` components and hitting "require is not defined" on Vercel Edge. Stacktrace shows CJS pulling in fs/process.

ali: Sounds like bundler picked the wrong entry. Do we have conditional exports or a dedicated edge/browser build?

marco: We ship dist/cjs, dist/esm, and dist/edge but package.json only sets main/module. Next sometimes resolves main for edge which is wrong.

ali: Short checklist: 1) add conditional exports (import/require/browser/worker/node); 2) expose explicit subpath `sdk/edge` and `sdk/node`; 3) avoid top-level process.env/fs references (lazy-read inside factory).

marco: Also add a small runtime guard in Node/CJS that throws an actionable error if pulled into a browser/edge runtime, e.g. "imported server SDK in browser/edge: use 'sdk/edge' or call from a server action/API route". Keep the guard tiny to avoid extra requires.

sophie.dev: docs: add quick examples for server action, server component, and API route patterns so customers see the right pattern for app-router.

sdk-bot: created ticket DEVEX-401: "nextjs app-router: exports + edge entry + runtime guard + docs" assigned to @marco.
